We've seen a dramatic increase in the wasp
population in recent days. Some of our top
scholars believe that this wasp explosion is
due to the decline of honey buzzards. The
scholars postulate that orcs have taken up
residence in the Ancient Temple Ruins and
are hunting the buzzards for food. Without
the buzzards consuming the wasps, the wasp
population is growing unchecked.

If their supply chain can be broken, the orcs
residing in the ruins will be forced to leave,
thus allowing the buzzard population to
rebound.

Destroying a recent orc shipment in the
harbor should be enough to encourage the
orcs' relocation.

For those who aren't adventurers, it is
extremely rare for a human to ever
encounter an elf. However, an elf shrouded
in a heavy coat recently filed a request
with the guild. 

Certain beasts have been sighted recently in
many areas: a beast with giant fangs and
small, bipedal dragons. These are known to be
special beasts that the dark elves used to
ride. This elf believes that the fact that these
beasts exist is proof that dark elves must also
still exist in this world.
 
The task requested of you is to face these
beasts and see if you can mount one as your
steed. Apparently, exerting dominance over
one of the dark elves' most formidable assets
would allay this fearful elf's concerns.

The flesh of the giant walking fungi, myconids,
is a legendary delicacy among gourmands.
However, myconids are also legendarily toxic.
The lethal poison that they produce means
that only a small portion of their bodies can
be rendered safe for consumption.

To balance the rampant demand for myconid
flesh with safety concerns, a group of
scholars would like to research how to cull
these creatures in a manner that would
provide the largest yield. They request that
someone gather myconid spores from
Wallace's Underground Labyrinth.

The hero Javleen's famed sword would be the
crowning object in any knight's collection.
However, a lesser-known relic of Javleen's
lies in the subterranean fortress. 

It is said that a noblewoman Javleen loved
gave him a handkerchief before the famous
battle against the orcs that claimed his life.
That noblewoman wept away the rest of her
days, dismayed that Javleen was unable to
fulfill his promise to return her favor.

Any soldier loyal to Hydeland would move
mountains in order to reclaim the
handkerchief from those filthy pigs.

Morgan Lisley, the witch who runs the magic
item shop, has always had a burning desire for
furthering the development and research of
magic items.

She has seized upon the idea of combining
highly elastic spider silk with magic in an
attempt to develop a fiber that would be
resilient against any kind of attack.

To test her idea, she requires some giant
spider webs. Go and acquire some for her.

A famous adventure ship called the Elliot,
which was thought to have been lost at sea,
has been sighted recently at a cove infested
with pirates.

An investor who had been financing the
adventures of Elliot Pid, the Elliot's owner, is
understandably curious about what became of
Mr. Pid. Please go and gain some information
on Mr. Pid's recent activity.

A man known for his habit of caring for the
many wild dogs on the outskirts of town
excitedly placed a request about hellhounds.
According to the man, they are strong,
beautiful, intelligent dogs that live in packs
and can control fire. However, he is
dismayed that they live in terrible conditions.

The man adamantly believes that he can
raise hellhounds to be less fearsome. Go and
provide firsthand proof that hellhounds aren't
harmful to humans. If you approach them
with love in your heart, he feels that they
will accept you, given their intelligence.

A magician who is researching golems and
necromancy has put in a request. He wants
you to search for an automatic doll that the
late tinkerer Henritta made.

This doll, crafted by Henritta, is said to have
been incredibly articulated. The requester
would like to use Henritta's technology to
allow his creations to have the same range
of movement. 

Go to Henritta's laboratory in the Mage's
Tower and find the automatic doll that is her
legacy. To gain entrance, you must figure out
how to pass a magical mechanism which bars
access. 

It is said that the mechanism that Henritta
most liked when she was alive was one that
would "reflect magic with a giant shield."

The king has always appointed the elves as
stewards of the forests. In times past, the
forests were the pride and joy of the elves,
said to be the most beautiful in all the land.

Now the once-magnificent forests have
degenerated into a haven of terror, danger,
and miasmas. There are reports of wood
golems menacing passersby and of people
entering the forests, never to be seen again.
We want to know what put the forests in this
state. Is there perhaps some kind of evil spell
or mystical force twisting the land?

In order to get to the bottom of this mystery,
we ask for your assistance to help the
patrollers destroy the wood golems. This will
allow us to search the area for clues.

If you ever happen upon an owlbear in the
forest, it will invariably attack you.
This is known.

These creatures were birthed as part of
some ungodly experiments. They escaped
into the forest and have been breeding ever
since. Owlbears' numbers have increased as
of late, and they are no longer confining
themselves to the forest. Some are even
reporting that councils of owlbears are
visible from their homes, and that fierce
owlbear attacks are wreaking havoc upon
their townsfolk and their trade.

I need you to cull the owlbear population, so
they will no longer stray from their habitat to
find food.

The fire-breathing dragon is a frightening
creature made by the gods in the days of
legends. 

The dragons, with their overwhelming power,
once ruled the land. However, since the
ancient dragon was sealed by the goddess,
they decreased in number. They do still exist,
and they are still quite powerful, though.
 
Recently, a piece of writing written in Elician
times concerning the origin of dragons was
uncovered in the Ancient Temple Ruins. 
I'd like you to search for other ancient works
that contain information regarding the origin
of dragons.

Killer fish are doing much damage to the
fishing industry. These finned fiends swarm
once every few years, consuming all the fish
(and sometimes humans) that they can find.

The damned things are out in especially high
numbers this year, and the fishermen brave
enough to attempt to deal with them are
getting slaughtered.

I need you to go out and exterminate these
killer fish from the local waterways.

Rickey, the rodent apprentice of the magician
Wallace, submitted a request for you.

Since his master's passing, his research into
the evolution of species has been abandoned.

His work was secreted away inside a treasure
box, which itself was locked in a cage, and
only the diminutive Rickey had the key.
However, he's since lost the key. He would
like you to open the treasure box and
reacquire the research. To access the
treasure box, you will need to step on the
colored switches in this order: Red, yellow,
navy, purple.

Rickey has specifically requested you for this
job, as he feels that you are the only one he
can trust.

During a battle with the orcs at Bilbaron
Fortress, we obtained information that the
goblins are constructing a flying fortress.
 
To finish their flying terror, they need the
dwarves' steam engine, but the dwarves are
held captive in the fortress. Not only that,
they hid the blueprint for it in a secret room
as an act of defiance. The goblins are
frantically looking for it. You must find the
blueprint and put a stop to their plans.

Be swift, as reports say the goblins have
already started using explosives to look for
rooms hidden behind the walls.

The hero Roland is very intrigued by the
night skeletons. Among the many common
skeletons, there are occasionally darker
skeleton warriors. Rumor has it that they are
not actually mindless servants controlled by
magicians, but that they are dead legendary
heroes. They are said to have escaped from
the underground cemetery, where they
congregate and train each other with their
swords. 

Roland throws you a provocative glance. Will
YOU be able to best the abilities of the
legendary undead warriors? Do battle with
them and report back on your experience.

A man who looks irresponsible with money
whispered in your ear a secret request.
A brigand crew about 40 strong is said to have
amassed a great deal of treasure in a hidden
cave in Ghost Ship Cove. A large stone that
seals the cave is said to open only with a
magical password, which the man says is
"Open The Sesame".

The man claimed that stealing the money
wasn't a crime, because it's filthy brigand
money. He also stated that the treasure was
all his, and that you don't get to lay a finger
on it.

A group of stout men in masks and scale mail
has made a request. They are most likely the
members of a dragon faith group. 

One of their former comrades had completed
some taboo research. After that man had been
dealt with, someone absconded with his
research documents. These men have a
source which told them that the documents
are in a hidden office belonging to one of the
leaders of the magic religion Morneon. 

They don't want Morneon misusing the
forbidden text, but they've been unable to
find the documents. There must be some
mechanism hiding everything. Find and disable
the mechanism to locate the hidden office
holding those documents.

We received a request from a woman who
works as a crystal sculptor. In the back of the
Lost Woods, there is a massive crystal trove.

Troves like this are valued for being locations
where one can harvest very pure amethysts.
The purer the amethyst, the better material it
will be for sculpting. However, crystal troves
exist in areas so remote that the requester
would never be able to travel to one herself.

You must go to the crystal trove and gather
as many amethysts as possible.

Harpies inhabit the Ancient Temple Ruins.
Researchers note that they are highly
intelligent, understand human language,
and display a variety of emotions. 

Therefore, they believe that there is a
possibility that if a harpy was raised by
humans from birth, it could be taught to
coexist with them. 

These researchers request eggs to proceed
with their research. Go and kill a harpy without
destroying its nest.

We've gotten a request for a wyvern egg from
a dragon-riding clan in a distant land. It's quite
difficult to breed wyverns, so the preferred
method for raising a wyvern mount is to steal
an egg.

A menagerie of wyverns is organized much
like a harem with one alpha male and a few
females. You are being tasked with traveling
into the valley behind the ruins of the old
capital and stealing a clutch of eggs from the
female while trying to steer clear of the male.

Inside the late magician Wallace's underground
maze, he had a magic lab where he was
studying the evolution of creatures. Without
Wallace overseeing the lab, his experiments
have now gone awry.

As a result, the doom beetles he housed there
are hatching at a much greater rate than they
would in the wild. Even their worm forms have
been becoming aggressive and violent.

Insect researchers would like to research
these violent worms. Please bring the bodily
fluids of five worms in their cocoons.

An urgent cooperation request has been
given to us by a patrol squad from a village
in western Hydeland. 

A number of village children who had been
kidnapped by orcs will be sacrificed to a
minotaur who lives in the depths of Bilbaron
Fortress. We must rescue them before that
happens.

One group will invade the fortress as a
distraction. You will follow them in and
defeat the minotaur, while the patrol squad
rescues the children. If the enemies that the
distraction is supposed to occupy notice
you, your escape will be that much harder.
This plan must be executed quickly for it to
have any chance of success.

This is a request from a female business
owner in a remote village. She reports the
girls who work at her shop have been
kidnapped by vampires, and further adds that
those girls, mere seamstresses, stayed up
late dreaming about actually wearing the
dresses they made. 

The shop owner claims that the lamps that her
employees were burning in order to stay awake,
as they fantasized about a life they could
never reach instead of knowing their places,
are obviously what attracted the vampires'
attentions.

She then adds that because she has no
workers, she can't afford to pay much as a
reward, and states that if you could bring even
one of the girls back to work posthaste, it
would help her business greatly.

This strange request was paid for in advance,
but no one seems to know who made it.

A magic lamp is now in the hands of pirates.
If the owner rubs the lamp while thinking of
a wish, he can have three wishes granted
to him. It is a legendary item famous through
all the world. The requester would like you to
grant his wish. Take possession of the lamp
and wish, "Free yourself."

We've got a new request from a man who
calls himself the best strategist of his era. 

In the Forgotten Sanctuary, a spell to control
statues freely has remained active. If you
could use this rune magic to control several
statues, you could mass produce golem
warriors to form an indomitable army, warding
off nearly all threats from foreign invasion.

Travel there and defeat the golems and
demons in the area, so that the runes may
be deciphered. You cannot activate the runes
while taking on this task.

An old magician appears, saying he recognizes
one of the leaders in the shadowy magic
religion of Morneon.

He says that in old times, many apprentice
magicians learned magic and wisdom at the
Mage's Tower, and there was a teacher there
that looked exactly like one of the Morneon
leaders. Confront him, and discover why he's
strayed to Morneon. 

The old magician says that in order to learn
the former teacher's past, you must look into
his memories directly. With the help of the old
magician, you can touch his temple with your
index finger once to peer inside, just once.
You must go alone, to get the target to
underestimate you.

Gazers, monsters with a giant eye, are the
bane of magicians. A gazer is able to nullify
magic with a look from its evil eye.
A researcher has proffered a theory that this
unnatural ability is proof that gazers are from
another world.

He says that he can glean information from a
gazer's soul in order to find out more about its
world.

With a mysterious urn in hand, he asks you to
defeat a gazer and bring back its soul in this
urn. However, the urn is extremely powerful,
and it may also claim the souls of any allies
around you. 

To limit casualties, you must complete this
quest alone.

The soldiers of the mountainous northern
kingdom of Bolga are known for their fearsome
bloodthirstiness. Some speculate that this is
because colosseum fights that were permitted
in ancient Elician times in Hydeland are still
going strong today in Bolga.

Bolgan fighting tournaments consist of forcing
prisoners of war to fight each other to the
death in an arena in front of a rabid audience.

We've received reports that a detachment
comprised of victorious gladiators are beginning
a clandestine invasion into our kingdom. 

Drive these proven warriors out of Hydeland
and thwart Bolga's stratagem.

A young knight, the eldest son from a long line
of knights, has run away from home, and his
father is desperately trying to find him.

The rumor surrounding this knight is that he
was agonizing over his dead girlfriend when he
was charmed by a harpy's magic. The harpy is
residing in the back of the Ancient Temple, 
the same spot where the knight was last seen.

The requester has asked to keep this discreet
so as not to heap even more shame upon the
family name. You must go alone.

Many people have attempted to sneak into the
former royal city in search of the riches there,
and have never returned. 

Rumors claim that the sound of a woman
speaking and weeping can be heard beyond a
wall somewhere in the ruins' halls. Adventurers
who break through the wall and pass through
find themselves in a cursed room filled with
treasure. The hole they made in the wall to
enter the room would magically seal itself. 

I want you to go into the hidden room and find
out what happened to them and their treasure.

Lima Ray is an evil witch who lived for two
hundred years. Her body was destroyed and
sealed far beneath the ground forty years ago
after the magician Wallace defeated her, but
many prophesies have predicted her
resurrection.

A source informed us that the goblins who
worship her are up to something. They're
skulking around a room in Wallace's
underground maze. If the goblins are stirring
up trouble, put an end to it.

The Chignac tribe is known as a fierce tribe of
warriors, even amongst the orcs. After claiming
the fortress, they show no signs of stopping as
they march on the kingdom. Politicians have
determined that it would be strategically wise
to form an alliance with a large Amazon tribe
to the south, to contain the Chignac orcs'
potential invasion routes.

To gain the trust of the noble and proud
Amazonians, one of us must pass the
Amazons' test to become a warrior.
Equip their ritual equipment and collect the
heads of 50 orcs.

The kidnapping of village girls by vampires has
still not stopped, and the mayor of the village
has asked a vampire hunter to exterminate
the vampires.

The church who rules over the region has put
up a demon-repelling barrier, but it has not had
the desired effect. This makes the church look
like they are making promises that they can't
honor.

I want you, as a holy knight of the church, to
go and kill the vampires off before the vampire
hunter can get there.

An aged woman came by with a request
regarding her former landlord's castle.
He loved parties and these bashes were
quite the rage among the citizens.

However, when the woman returned to the
castle after a long break, the landlord's family
had died off from illness, and the castle was
sealed shut.

The castle is now replete with ghosts, and this
woman believes that these spirits are the
deceased landlord and his family. If one were
to greet the landlord by spinning and dancing in
front of him, they may tell you the truth.

The requester would like you to contact the
ghosts in order to determine what happened
to her former landlord.

In the ruins in the ancient temple, there are
wall paintings of strange beings. They seem
like they may be depicting great sea serpents,
legendary creatures spoken of in ancient
times.

Their habitat, as recorded in the old texts, is
presently teeming with kraken, so researchers
cannot investigate the area.

Go there on behalf of the scientists and see if
there's any indication that the great sea
serpents once roamed there.

Aside from the magic religion Morneon, there
are other, lesser known magical heresy cults.

Of these fringe groups, the most controversial
is the "Hell Evangelists". One of them has
requested to speak to someone of the
kingdom, seeking to expose secrets of
Morneon.

They say they must test the messenger,
however. Only the one who can open the
magically sealed door and can show with
runes the answer to "where all living things
go" can be acknowledged as the messenger.
Decipher their riddle and act as the 
messenger.

A monk confessed his problem. It's been thirty
years since he gave his life to the Goddesses,
hoping for inner peace, but he was fighting his
lust all those years.

Recently, incubi have been inviting him to join
them in depravity. He must not be allowed to
give into the demons' temptations. He has
already flogged himself many times, but they
still haunt his dreams.

I want you to go destroy the statue of the
false god in the Forgotten Sanctuary, that
compound of evil, in the hopes that it will
help him resist giving in to depravity.

There's an old weaver who told me a story
from when she was young. She touched a
magic carpet, and from that moment forward,
she dedicated her life to crafting something
that was of equal quality.

Despite giving her entire life to the craft, she
was never able to duplicate the level of
craftsmanship that was employed in making
that carpet she remembered from her youth.

She handed over what little money she had,
entreating the Guild to discover the secret
behind that masterwork. She would take it to
her grave. I need you to go see if there's 
anything having to do with creating this carpet
in the Mage's Tower, where the carpet is kept.

A man who lost his memories has sent us a
request. He was saved from drowning in the 
lake in the Lost Woods, and his memory of 
anything before that is fuzzy.

He's been dreaming lately of a crying woman 
calling to him from the bottom of the lake, 
even waking up in the middle of the night with 
these dreams. He thinks the woman in his 
dreams has to do with his lost memories. 
However, he says his wife adamantly refuses 
to allow him to go anywhere near the lake.

You must get on a boat in the depths of the 
Lost Woods and find out if there's a woman at 
the bottom of the lake.

The Church of Althena, the governing body of
Canaan Temple, is trying to expand their 
efforts to gain followers and glorify their
goddesses.

They are striving to show the populace the 
power and achievements of Althena's miracles 
by resurrecting adventurers at the temple.

However, the monks' prayers do not reach the 
adventurers who have perished within the 
dangerous labyrinths. If their bones are left 
uninterred for too long, the death god will 
come and reap their souls swiftly.

Bring back as many bones as possible from
the labyrinths in the monks' stead, and
resurrect them at the temple.

Medusa is a snake monster who appeared deep
within the ancient ruins. The moment you look
into her beautiful, gem-like eyes, you will
become a mineral yourself. At least, that's
what the myths say.

These myths are important, because Medusa
has apparently returned from those days of
myth. The knights' order that the Temple is
affiliated with is trying to perform a ritual to
put Medusa to rest by following the old legend,
which states that it was done by severing
Medusa's head and offering it to the goddess.

However, many knight-monks have been 
turned into stone while trying to attempt this. 
As one of the strongest in our guild, we ask 
you to go alone, and return with Medusa's
head.

In an outer region, there exists a legend of a
princess who saved the kingdom by offering 
herself to a red dragon, the most terrifying of 
dragons. Now, a new religion worshipping her 
has sprouted up.

The Church cannot condone anyone 
worshipping anything that is not their
goddesses, so this concerns them.

The request is that you present yourself as a 
holy knight representing their religion, and slay 
the red dragon by the power and protection 
of their gods in order to spread their word to 
the unenlightened populace.

Deeper in Wallace's Underground Labyrinth lies 
a prison holding a myopia of cyclopes.

These creatures are said to have been alive 
since the days of mythology. They waged 
multiple wars against the three goddesses, and 
have tried to invade the human world. Each 
time, the gods and heroes have controlled or 
sealed them.

Sources have informed us that members of 
the Morneon religion are conspiring to free 
these dangerous cyclopes and sow chaos.
You are to covertly surveil the underground 
labyrinth and discern their plans, and, if 
necessary, put a stop to them.

A dwarf who was one of the architects of
Bilbaron Fortress has come to you with a
surefire plan to destroy Gargoyle Gate.

No matter how you tried to destroy the gate 
once and for all, the goblins would simply fix it, 
allowing the enemy to further entrench 
themselves. 

However, the architect has informed us that 
there is a hidden passageway that only the 
architects would know of. He will enter 
through this passageway and weaken the gate 
from the inside.

The army doesn't wish to expend any more 
forces, so you and the dwarf will need to go 
rogue to complete this mission off the books. 
Travel to Gargoyle Gate alone and attract the 
enemy army's attention while the dwarf 
weakens the gate from within, then finish the 
gate off.

There are a growing number of believers who 
are staunchly opposed to the resurrection of 
the dead.

A certain young man is trying to resurrect
his girlfriend who was killed by monsters.
However, her father is among the group
of anti-resurrection zealots and adamantly
opposes bringing her back to life.

Before her funeral happens, the young man
and his friends plan to steal the girl's corpse
so she can be resurrected. He requests that
someone defeat the death god as it comes
to claim her soul. If you take too long to
deal with it, the anti-resurrection fanatics
will become aware of your efforts, and
attempt to stymie you.

The female pirate Anna Bonnie is a venerable 
legend amongst men of the sea for having 
defeated a kraken with only a dagger. One man 
insults those who believe the legend, saying 
it's an obvious fabrication. Another is 
spellbound by the tales and insists that they 
are undeniably true. Still another drunkenly 
boasts that slaying a kraken with a dagger is 
easy, and that he knows others who could
do it.

And so he has come to the guild, requesting 
that someone pose as his friend and defeat a 
kraken. He won't restrict you to only using a 
dagger, but he does ask that you go about this 
task alone.

The Forgotten Sanctuary stands as a
monument to the temerity of humanity's
boundless ambition, much like the chastened
tower of antiquity that dared to reach to the
heavens. Does mankind believe omniscience
can be gained in the brief fluttering of a single
lifetime?

It seems at least one man does: a scholar who
has come to you with a request. He claims he
signed a contract with the devil that would
allow him to gain all the knowledge in the
world... in exchange for his body and soul.

While the devil is under his contractual control,
he can sate his every worldly desire. However,
after a certain period, the terms of his
contract will be executed.

It has been twenty-four years since the
contract, and he's starting to hear the bells of
hell tolling for him. He wants you to go to the
Forgotten Sanctuary alone and convince the
devil to have a change of heart.

A potential officer of a religious group came to 
us in a cold sweat with this request, after 
realizing that in his religion, praying to God 
does not guarantee equal blessings to all. He 
then realized that if God won't save the 
faithful who are sick, humans must do their 
utmost to aid them.

He wants you to capture chimerae, that evil 
magicians have produced, in order to subvert 
their evil magic and use it to aid citizens as a 
supplement to his god's blessings. However, his 
church has declared any research into 
unnatural life verboten, which means this 
request needs to be completed secretly.

A duke from Bolga has come to us. He says 
he will pay a handsome reward if you can 
single-handedly slay the Killer Rabbit in the
Lost Woods.

This killer rabbit is known as an extremely 
dangerous monster. The bones of nearly 500 
people lay strewn about its lair. It is reportedly 
the most foul, cruel, and bad-tempered 
creature anyone's laid eyes on. 

Something about this request is amiss, so stay 
on your guard. Complete the request and 
discover the true intentions of this duke from 
an enemy land.

The fairy Tiki has learned enough human 
language to request something of you.

Since knowledge of rune magic has spread 
throughout the kingdom through the Morneon 
religion, many have begun using it for evil 
purposes, such as capturing fairies to use as 
mediums for their spells.

She produces some coins and asks if you 
could help her friends the same way you 
saved her.

At ##(COLOR_R_MR), destroy the orcs'
cargo found at the harbor.

Kill 10 enemies while riding atop a
dragonlisk or sabertooth.
Collect 10 spores from the myconids.

At ##(COLOR_R_UC), open
the treasure chests without waking the
sleeping orcs.

Slay giant spiders and gather 5 strands of
spider silk.

Search for clues aboard the famed Elliot
at ##(COLOR_R_GC).
Withstand 5 attacks from a hellhound.

On the first floor of ##(COLOR_R_MT),
deflect magic with a giant shield and look
for a doll in the opened room.
At ##(COLOR_R_LW), destroy 30 wood golems.
Slay 10 owlbears.

Investigate the room behind the wall painting
in the ##(COLOR_R_MR).
Slay 10 killer fish.

In a lab of ##(COLOR_R_MD), 
step on the floor switches in the proper order 
to open the chest.

Find the treasure chest hidden in
